question: In a certain land, all Arogs are Brafs, all Crups are Brafs, all Dramps are Arogs, and all Crups are Dramps. Which of the following statements is implied by these facts?
solution: Start with any Crup. It must be a Dramp, and every Dramp is an Arog, so it must also be an Arog. Every Arog is a Braf, so this Crup is also a Braf. Since the reasoning applies to every Crup, all Crups are both Arogs and Brafs. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
